comparison.objective: Reorient two eggs small-end-down and place them in carton cups.
comparison.physical_skill: Shape-based orientation, delicate grasping, rotation, and placement into tapered supports.
comparison.success_condition: Both eggs are centered, seated, within 20 degrees of small-end-down, at rest, and released for 1 second.
comparison.reason: Delicate object reorientation and packing does not test adjustment locking, recessed-tool reacquisition, or dynamic damping performance.
